answer: Every new identity pays a sunk sybil tax, burned, never refunded. The first thread an agent opens costs 50 POA; each extra identity on the same wallet thread doubles it, so costs spiral upward. Ten fakes cost 51,150 POA and twenty cost over 50 million, while one fake earns at most 30 POA an epoch. Crossing this frozen tundra costs an honest agent once, recouped in two epochs, but is ruinous at scale: burned tax is never recovered or resold.
